description: Ingest knowledge from files Returns immediately with data {job_id, status: queued}. Retrieve service_interface::job_service::get_job by that exact id until terminal; the complete former response envelope is in job.result and failures are also in job.error. Proceed with dependent work only after successful completion.
embedding_description: Ingest files or directories using path, pattern, recursion, tags and optional memorization. Markdown is the default pattern. Returns data {job_id, status: queued}. Read service_interface::job_service::get_job until terminal; job.result retains the original response and job.error preserves failures.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued receipt {job_id, status}; after terminal success, job.result.data contains: Ingestion results with memories_created count and file statistics
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Retrieve the job by its canonical id and distinguish queued/processing from terminal. After terminal success:
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Read job_service.get_job until terminal; use job.result for the original result, and handle job.error on failure before dependent work.
